(SALES TAX RENEWAL)

SUMMARY:  RENEWAL OF A 1/2% SALES AND USE TAX FOR 7 YEARS FOR MAINTAINING, OPERATING AND/OR IMPROVING THE WEST FELICIANA PARISH HOSPITAL;	PROVIDED, HOWEVER, THAT THE POLICE JURY IS FURTHER AUTHORIZED TO REDUCE SAID TAX TO THE EXTENT THAT THE POLICE JURY DETERMINES THAT THE PROCEEDS OF SAID SALES TAX ARE NOT REQUIRED FOR THE OPERATION OF THE HOSPITAL.
